Sure, my user ID is liam_khan_2521. I don’t have my reservation ID handy—can you look it up with my user ID?

I’m not sure which one it is just by the reservation ID. Could you give me a bit more detail about each one, like the number of passengers or the departure time? That would help me figure out which reservation I need to change.

Yes, that’s correct—I want to move the IAH to SEA flight to May 24 for all three of us, and upgrade to business class for all passengers. The rest of the itinerary can stay the same. Can you let me know if that’s possible and what the total extra cost would be?
Could you give me a bit more detail about Option 1 and Option 2, like how long the layover is in LAS for each? That would help me decide which one works best for us.

Thanks for the details. I think Option 1 would work better for us since the layover is during the day. Please go ahead and check the total extra cost for moving to Option 1 and upgrading all flights in the reservation to business class. Let me know what the total would be before making any changes.

That’s a lot higher than I was expecting. Is there any way to bring the total extra cost down? Maybe there are other business class options or different connections that would be less expensive? I’d really like to make this work if possible.

Please look for lower business class fares for all segments—IAH to SEA, SEA to JFK, and JFK to IAH. I want to see if there’s any way to get the total extra cost under $1000 for the whole reservation. Let me know what you find!

I really want to move the IAH to SEA flight and upgrade to business class, but I can’t go over $1000 for the total extra cost. Is there anything else you can suggest—maybe different dates, airlines, or even splitting the upgrade between outbound and return flights—that could help get the price down? I’m open to any options that keep the total under $1000.

I’d appreciate it if you could check all of those options and let me know the costs for each. I’m mainly interested in moving the IAH to SEA flight to May 24 and upgrading to business class, but I want to see if any combination can get me under $1000 total. Thanks for helping me look into this!

I really need to move the IAH to SEA flight to May 24 specifically, and I don’t want to change the date without upgrading to business class. Is there absolutely no way to get business class on May 24 for that segment under $1000 total? If not, are there any last-minute deals or waitlist options for business class upgrades on May 24 that could help bring the price down? I’m willing to consider anything as long as I can get business class on May 24 and stay within my budget.

Thanks for checking everything. Since it’s not possible to get business class on May 24 within my budget, I’ll hold off on making any changes for now. If anything opens up or prices drop, please let me know. I appreciate your help! 

###STOP###
